gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding (145.3) taken from Balance Sheet (gross claims outstanding, 2021 comparative). No explicit gross prioryear reserve movement (movement in prior years, gross) was provided in the notes; the technical reserves reconciliation shows total movement in gross claims (which includes current year movements) but not a separate 'movement in prior year claims' gross figure. The report references adverse prioryear development due to specific natural catastrophe events but does not quantify gross PYD. Gross premium mix percentages were presented as percentages of gross premiums earned (not written); amounts were approximated by applying those percentages to gross premiums written (80.4) - see note. _claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development table is present in the technical provisions note (gives ultimate losses, paid claims and gross outstanding by underwriting year).
